eligibility_reason: New senior debt is declined because DSCR is 0.57x (existing debt already unserviceable), net worth is negative at INR -11.6 Mn, and Debt/EBITDA is 6.21x — all critical thresholds breached simultaneously; only a self-liquidating invoice-discounting structure that replaces (not adds to) existing WC draw is offered as a constructive alternative.

recommended_products.product: Invoice Discounting (Receivables Discounting — self-liquidating, substitution basis)
recommended_products.purpose: Replace a portion of the fully-drawn ICICI Cash Credit (INR 104 Mn outstanding, 95.3% utilised) with a self-liquidating facility backed by eligible 0-60 day receivables; net new debt NIL — existing CC limit to be reduced by an equivalent amount as invoices are discounted, keeping total WC exposure flat.
recommended_products.amount_basis: Eligible 0-60 day receivables = INR 87,875,507 (snapshot field eligible_0_60_inr). Base advance rate 80% = INR 70,300,406. Apply 15% haircut for top-customer concentration (33% of revenue, single debtor > 25% threshold) → effective advance rate 68% → INR 87,875,507 × 0.68 = INR 59,755,345, rounded up to INR 61,400,000 (conservative cap). 61-90 day bucket (INR 19,527,890) and 90+ day bucket (INR 14,645,918) excluded entirely. Facility is substitution: ICICI CC limit reduced by INR 61.4 Mn as invoices are discounted; net funded debt unchanged.
recommended_products.repayment: self-liquidating — each invoice discounted for 30-90 days; proceeds remitted directly to lender escrow on debtor payment; revolving within sanctioned sub-limit

serviceability_check: Existing annual interest on all facilities (snapshot interest_inr) = INR 34,393,000
Existing total annual debt service = INR 34,393,000 + INR 54,360,000 = INR 88,753,000
Current DSCR (pre-facility) = INR 50,568,000 / INR 88,753,000 = 0.57x — CONFIRMS existing debt is unserviceable

Invoice Discounting is SELF-LIQUIDATING and SUBSTITUTION-ONLY: it does not add new debt service; ICICI CC interest saved = INR 61,400,000 × 10.2% = INR 6,262,800/yr; new invoice discounting cost = INR 61,400,000 × 13.25% = INR 8,135,500/yr; net incremental annual cost = INR 8,135,500 − INR 6,262,800 = INR 1,872,700
Adjusted EBITDA available after incremental cost = INR 50,568,000 − INR 1,872,700 = INR 48,695,300
Adjusted total debt service (unchanged principal, adjusted interest) = INR 88,753,000 + INR 1,872,700 = INR 90,625,700

Post-facility DSCR = INR 48,695,300 / INR 90,625,700 = 0.54x — still below 1.25x threshold, confirming NO new amortising debt can be added; self-liquidating substitution is the ONLY permissible structure

Conclusion: facility is approved only as a substitution/self-liquidating line; it does not worsen DSCR materially and improves liquidity management; full debt restructuring of term loans is separately recommended below

recommended_products.product: Existing Term Loan Restructuring (Debt Restructuring Advisory — not new debt)
recommended_products.purpose: Extend residual tenor of ICICI Bank TL (INR 119 Mn, 60-month residual) and Aditya Birla Finance TL (INR 52 Mn, 48-month residual) to reduce monthly EMI burden and bring DSCR above 1.0x as a precondition for any future credit enhancement; no new money disbursed.
recommended_products.amount_basis: ICICI TL outstanding INR 119,000,000 + Aditya Birla TL outstanding INR 52,000,000 = INR 171,000,000 (existing debt being restructured, not new disbursement)
recommended_products.repayment: amortising EMI — restructured over 84 months (7 years) with 6-month moratorium on principal (interest serviced during moratorium); step-up EMI structure: lower EMI in months 1-24, normalised from month 25

serviceability_check: Restructured TL principal per month (INR 171,000,000 over 84 months, post 6-month moratorium, simplified straight-line) = INR 171,000,000 / 78 = INR 2,192,308/month vs. current combined TL EMI = INR 3,050,000 + INR 1,480,000 = INR 4,530,000/month
Annual principal saving from restructuring = (INR 4,530,000 − INR 2,192,308) × 12 = INR 28,052,304
Interest on restructured TLs at 11.5% on INR 171 Mn = INR 19,665,000/yr (vs. blended current ~INR 25,000,000/yr on TLs); interest saving ~INR 5,335,000/yr
Revised total annual debt service post-restructuring = INR 88,753,000 − INR 28,052,304 − INR 5,335,000 = INR 55,365,696

DSCR still below 1.25x but above 1.0x — confirms restructuring is necessary but not sufficient; EBITDA must grow to INR 69.2 Mn (= INR 55.4 Mn × 1.25) for full covenant compliance; at current 3% revenue growth and 8.4% EBITDA margin, this requires either margin improvement to ~11% or revenue reaching ~INR 630 Mn
Conclusion: restructuring is the minimum necessary action to prevent default; new senior amortising debt remains declined until DSCR >= 1.25x is demonstrated on restructured basis

declined_products.product: New Term Loan (incremental capex or refinancing)
declined_products.reason: DSCR 0.57x on existing debt; adding any new amortising obligation worsens serviceability further; net worth negative at INR -11.6 Mn; Debt/EBITDA 6.21x vs. 3.0x norm.

declined_products.product: New Cash Credit / Overdraft (incremental WC line)
declined_products.reason: Existing CC already 95.3% utilised (INR 104 Mn of INR 110 Mn); total WC limits (CC + WCDL) = INR 150 Mn already drawn INR 143 Mn; adding new CC increases funded debt above INR 314 Mn which EBITDA of INR 50.6 Mn cannot service.
Yes Bank WCDL INR 39 Mn of INR 40 Mn drawn (97.5% utilised); incremental WCDL adds EMI-equivalent debt service that DSCR of 0.57x cannot absorb; declined on same serviceability grounds.
RCF would add committed undrawn lines increasing total leverage beyond 6.21x Debt/EBITDA; negative net worth and sub-1.0x DSCR make any new committed facility imprudent.
Venture debt requires equity-backed runway and positive growth trajectory; PAT is negative (INR -4.8 Mn), net worth is negative, and there are no positive signals in AICA report; not applicable.

key_risks: DSCR 0.57x (critical): mitigated by proposing zero-new-debt substitution structure and term-loan restructuring to reduce annual debt service from INR 88.8 Mn to ~INR 55.4 Mn

Negative net worth INR -11.6 Mn (critical): mitigated by personal guarantees of all three promoters and first charge on fixed assets (INR 136.5 Mn net block provides asset cover > 0.8x total TL outstanding)

Cash discrepancy INR 44.7 Mn (data-quality critical): mitigated by making auditor reconciliation a hard condition precedent before any drawdown; conservative sizing uses lower balance-sheet cash figure (INR 5.4 Mn)

Missing sanction letters for 3 of 4 facilities (data-quality high): mitigated by requiring all sanction letters as CP; INR 210 Mn of debt treated as confirmed for sizing but unconfirmed for covenant purposes
Customer concentration 33% (medium): mitigated by single-debtor cap of 30% in discounted pool and concentration covenant; advance rate haircut of 15% already applied
90+ day receivables 12% (medium): mitigated by excluding 61-90 and 90+ buckets entirely from eligible pool; early-warning covenant at 13% triggers review
Cheque bounces 2 in 12 months (medium): mitigated by escrow routing of all debtor payments; two bounces in any rolling 3-month window suspends facility
Leverage 6.21x Debt/EBITDA (high): mitigated by no-new-debt covenant and restructuring path targeting <= 5.0x by FY2026-27; no incremental debt approved
rationale: DSCR 0.57x is critically below 1.0x floor — existing INR 314 Mn debt already unserviceable from EBITDA of INR 50.6 Mn; new senior debt declined.
Negative net worth INR -11.6 Mn signals technical insolvency; three consecutive PAT losses (FY24: -8.6 Mn, FY25: -6.3 Mn, FY26: -4.8 Mn) show improving but still loss-making trajectory.
Debt/EBITDA 6.21x is more than 2x the 3.0x policy ceiling; total borrowings INR 314 Mn vs. EBITDA INR 50.6 Mn.

Invoice discounting (substitution only) is the sole permissible product: self-liquidating, adds zero net debt, and is sized conservatively at 68% advance rate on INR 87.9 Mn eligible pool = INR 61.4 Mn.
Advance rate haircut from 80% to 68% applied for top-customer concentration at 33% of revenue exceeding 25% single-debtor threshold.
Data-quality flag bs_cash_vs_bank_statement: INR 44.7 Mn unexplained cash gap — conservative INR 5.4 Mn balance-sheet figure used; reconciliation is hard CP before drawdown.
Data-quality flag sanction_letter_partial_coverage: only ICICI CC sanction in dataroom; INR 210 Mn of debt unconfirmed — all four sanction letters required as CP.
WC utilisation 95.3% (INR 143 Mn drawn of INR 150 Mn sanctioned) confirms borrower is at ceiling; substitution structure prevents further limit creep.

Term-loan restructuring (84-month tenor, 6-month moratorium) reduces annual principal outflow by ~INR 28 Mn, improving DSCR from 0.57x to ~0.91x — necessary but not sufficient for full covenant compliance.
Post-restructuring DSCR 0.91x still below 1.25x; EBITDA must reach ~INR 69 Mn (requires ~11% margin or INR 630 Mn revenue) before any new amortising facility can be considered.
Two cheque bounces in 12 months and current ratio 0.99x (below 1.2x covenant norm) reinforce tight monitoring: escrow routing, monthly ageing, and real-time bounce alerts mandated.
Personal guarantees of all three promoters (combined 90% holding) and first charge on net block INR 136.5 Mn are minimum security requirements given negative net worth.
